_why: RT-2, measured in Watauga: 47,388 rows / 46,253 distinct parno, and the 9.4% duplication concentrates in the >20-acre band — exactly the large tracts this tool exists to find. Row 2 is an EXACT duplicate of row 1 (collapses). Rows 3 and 4 share one parno with DIFFERING acreage: a multi-part parcel that must aggregate to 40.0 acres, never overwrite down to 12.0. Row 5 has parno = '' — the empty STRING, so `if (id === null)` does not catch it.
